title: Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs — Hobah Translation
about: Twelve testamentary discourses attributed to the sons of Jacob. The surviving Greek corpus is transmitted through Christian manuscripts and contains material whose Jewish, Christian, and redactional layers remain disputed. Hobah keeps the received material rather than silently deleting passages judged secondary.

translation.status: Hobah complete modern-English rendering from public-domain historical translation
translation.base_text: The complete public-domain Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs text in Rutherford H. Platt Jr., The Forgotten Books of Eden (1926), chapter pages hosted by Sacred-Texts, ultimately dependent on earlier public-domain scholarly translation of the Greek manuscript tradition
translation.method: Complete conservative Hobah modernization of a public-domain historical English witness. Archaic pronouns and verbal forms are normalized while content, testament order, and chapter divisions are retained. This is an original Hobah modern-English rendering of a public-domain witness, not falsely presented as a new critical edition freshly collated from all Greek manuscripts.
translation.confidence: High for preservation of the public-domain witness; medium for the underlying ancient text because recension and interpolation questions are substantial
translation.notes: All twelve patriarchal testaments are retained. Suspected Christian interpolation is not silently removed; the About This Text panel should disclose the textual history.
translation.license_note: The ancient text and the 1926 public-domain historical English witness are public domain. Hobah modernization is newly prepared for this project.
